facts.business: Onelife Capital Advisors Limited provides advisory services, broking services, and trading services through its segments.

auditor.name: Ajay Kumar & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters include evaluation of provision and contingent liabilities, assessment of carrying value of equity investments in subsidiaries, cybersecurity incident and reconstruction of financial information, Rights Issue and utilisation of issue proceeds, and investment in share warrants.

key_risks: Significant open litigation and contingent liabilities
Erosion of net worth in subsidiaries with accumulated losses
Cybersecurity incident (ransomware) on 30th Jan 2026 leading to data corruption and reconstruction of financial information
Utilisation of Rights Issue proceeds (75% utilised, 25% unutilised as at 31 March 2026)
Investment in share warrants of Swojas Food Limited with recoverability assessment
facts.related_party_note: The Company has granted loans to its Subsidiaries during the year in review. The Company has received back loans/advances granted. Please refer to the Note No. 32 "Disclosure of Related Parties Transactions" of Notes to the Financial Statements for the year ended March 31, 2026.
